landmarks.name: Redpath Museum
facts: It shows natural history collections, from dinosaur skeletons to Egyptian mummies.
It opened in 1882 and is one of the oldest buildings in Canada built for public exhibits.

landmarks.name: Arts Building
facts: It is the oldest building on campus, at the top of the main drive.
It was restored by EVOQ Architecture in 2016 to preserve its heritage.

landmarks.name: McConnell Engineering Building
facts: It houses the School of Computer Science.
It was donated in 1959 by a major benefactor who sat on the Board of Governors.

landmarks.name: Bronfman Building
facts: It houses the management faculty; its second floor reopened in 2012 as a Business Intelligence Centre with a trading room.
It opened in 1971 with the support of a Montreal whisky-distilling family.

landmarks.name: Leacock Building
facts: It was meant to have two towers, but the second was never built.
It was built between 1962 and 1965 by the Montreal firm Arcop.

landmarks.name: Royal Victoria College
facts: Its tower became mixed-gender in 2010, while its west wing is still for women only.
It opened in 1899 as a residential college for women.

landmarks.name: Macdonald-Harrington Building
facts: It is home to the Schools of Architecture and Urban Planning.
It was built between 1896 and 1897 as the chemistry building.

landmarks.name: Chancellor Day Hall
facts: It is home to the Faculty of Law.
Its newer section was completed in 1967, designed by Bland, Lemoyne, Edwards and Shine.

landmarks.name: University Centre
facts: It is the student union building.
In 1992 students voted in a referendum to rename it after actor and alumnus William Shatner.

landmarks.name: Burnside Hall
facts: It is a Brutalist building completed in 1970 by Marshall, Merrett and Associates.

landmarks.name: Molson Hall
facts: The library was in this west wing of the Arts Building from 1862 to 1893.

landmarks.name: Redpath Hall
facts: It is a concert hall that was once the main library's reading room.
The library opened here in 1893.

landmarks.name: Faculty Club
facts: It was built in 1912 as a residence and is now a gathering place for professors.

landmarks.name: Purvis Hall
facts: It is a Golden Square Mile mansion now owned by the university.

landmarks.name: Duggan House
facts: It is a mansion built in 1861 that the university now owns.
